markers.name: Extraction portal (southern Euclid anomaly)
markers.description: The lone static extraction portal sits at the top of a southern gravity anomaly known as a "Euclid". Occasionally, other extraction portals appear.

metadata.conditions: Works until the raid timer runs out.
